addon.heading: Career tools add-on
addon.note: Separate from your FlacronCV plan above, which it never changes.

overview.title: Career tools
overview.subtitle: Job search, interview practice and your career profile
overview.creditsError: Could not load your credits. Pull to refresh.
overview.creditsNote: Career credits are separate from your FlacronCV AI credits and are used only by the career tools. Editing, saving and exporting a draft uses none.

off.title: Career tools are not available in this app
off.body: Your FlacronCV plan, CVs, cover letters and Job Tracker work as usual.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: Career tools need a connection. Nothing was changed. Try again when you are back online.

unavailable.title: Career tools are unavailable right now
unavailable.body: The career service did not answer. Nothing was changed. Please try again later.

inactive.title: Career tools are unavailable for this account
inactive.body: Your FlacronCV account is not active.

notIncluded.title: Career tools are not included in your plan
notIncluded.body: Career tools are an optional add-on with their own credits. Your FlacronCV plan, its benefits and its AI credits stay exactly as they are.

access.localFixture: Local test entitlement for this demo. It is not a purchase and nothing was charged.
access.purchase: A separate add-on beside your FlacronCV plan. Cancelling it ends only the career tools; your FlacronCV plan continues.
access.pastDue: The last payment for the add-on failed. Access continues until the end of the paid period.

profile.title: Career profile
profile.body: Add, edit, confirm or remove the facts your drafts are built from; import a resume and set your preferences.

documents.title: Career drafts
documents.body: Create, generate, tailor, edit and save career CVs and letters; switch layouts, check readability, export and share.

opportunities.title: Job search
opportunities.body: Search your listings, paste a job advert, check it and compare it with your career CV. New listings from public company job boards are added every hour.

map.title: Map session
map.body: Listings as a list with approximate locations. No map tiles are connected.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.body: Saved searches, places, followed companies and the listings they surface.

tracker.title: Job Tracker
tracker.body: Your applications stay in the FlacronCV Job Tracker.

outcomes.title: Application outcomes
outcomes.body: Observed counts from your Job Tracker. Not a hiring probability.

evidence.title: Evidence vault
evidence.body: Add, edit and delete proof of your work; attach a photo of a certificate.

portfolios.title: Portfolio pages
portfolios.body: Choose work to show, publish or make a private link, share it and show its QR code.

interviews.title: Interview practice
interviews.body: Text interview practice, your sessions and STAR stories.

voice.title: Voice practice
voice.body: Answer out loud and record it. You can remove the recording at any time.

actionPacks.title: Action packs
actionPacks.body: Turn a saved opportunity into a tailored application pack with a checklist.

learning.title: Learning plans
learning.body: Skill gaps, milestones and a project brief for a target role.

maintenance.title: Career maintenance
maintenance.body: Log achievements and promotion goals; see credentials due within 90 days.

scenarios.title: Scenario planner
scenarios.body: Compare up to three routes. Missing pay stays unknown.

relocation.title: Relocation and career modes
relocation.body: Target locations, relocation plans and the specialist lens for your drafts.

recruiting.title: Recruiting opt-in
recruiting.body: Choose whether employers may see that you opted in. Your email stays private.

services.title: Human review
services.body: A person reviews selected material. Not bookable yet.

data.title: Career data
data.body: Export a copy of your career records.

forms.title: Application form filling
forms.body: Uses the desktop browser extension; not available on phones.

errors.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this.

outcomes.notIncludedTitle: Outcome analytics are not included in your career plan
outcomes.notIncludedBody: Your applications in the Job Tracker are unchanged.
outcomes.countsNote: Counts come from your applications in the Job Tracker. Interviews include offers. This is not a hiring probability.
